scope: All 103 numbered result rows from the surviving PropertyAuctions AID 494 grid for the 14 May 2007 Savills Commercial sale. The archived first-party Savills page identifies the date, states a total of 103 lots across six catalogue pages and exposes lots 1-20 on page 1. Those first 20 rows reconcile exactly to the secondary grid. The secondary grid exposes lots 1-103 exactly once and reports Offered: 103. Combined-sale result wording is preserved in raw evidence. Street addresses and postcodes are not exposed and remain null.
completion_scope: all numbered lots 1-103 appear exactly once in the result grid and reconcile to both the first-party total of 103 and the secondary Offered: 103 denominator
